title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-07
content:
Exec staff sync prep - 2026-03-07

Meeting time: Mon 2026-03-08 09:00 PT (30m)
Location: Zoom / Exec room
Objective: Quick alignment on the 90-day priorities, Dedicated capacity rollout risks, and top customer escalations. Leave with clear owners for follow-ups.

Attendees (tentative): Jordan Lee (owner), Asha Patel (CPO), Miguel Santos (CTO), Claire Nguyen (Head of Sales), Priya Rao (VP SRE)

Agenda (draft):
1) Quick wins / highlights (5m)
   - Dedicated GA checklist: infra pass done, docs in progress (Asha)
   - Hosted API latency 95p down to 120ms for small models after kernel tuning (Miguel)
   - Signed 2 mid-market Dedicated contracts (Claire)

2) Dedicated rollout risks & mitigation (10m)
   - Current risk: capacity contention in us-west for Dedicated customers during peak (observability spike yesterday)
     * Notes: autoscaler did not trigger for two nodes; investigating metrics/alert thresholds (Priya)
     * Ask: prioritize a hotfix or escalate to release-engineering? If hotfix, timeline = 48h.
   - Possible mitigation: temporary routing policy to route Dedicated to us-east for affected customers (short-term)

3) Customer escalations (5m)
   - AcmeHealth (HIPAA) — private deploy timeline slipped; legal review outstanding on KMS config (Claire).
   - OmniFin — observed token-charge spikes for embedding jobs; suspected batching regression after v1.4 rollout (Asha + infra).

4) Metrics we should surface (5m)
   - Platform: 95p latency (hosted), p99 tail, token cost per 1k for top models, Dedicated cluster utilization, error rate (5xx) by region.
   - Proposed one-slide snapshot: Miguel to prepare quick top-line numbers by EOD.

5) Decisions & rollouts (3m)
   - Canary for v1.4 rollback policy: do we hold or proceed? Need thumbs up from Miguel and Priya.

6) Parking lot & AOB (2m)

Prep notes / talking points: 
- Emphasize to execs that Dedicated growth is healthy but ops friction is the gating issue right now. We need a crisp story on short-term capacity controls + 90-day infra roadmap.
- For AcmeHealth, emphasize we need legal + infra alignment this week; if we miss SLA date, risk downgrades.
- Highlight the successful latency improvement but caution that the p99 for long-context remains unstable.

Follow-ups / Action items (clear owner + due date):
- Priya: Run post-mortem on autoscaler miss; include metric thresholds and alerting gap. Due: 2026-03-10.
- Miguel: One-slide metrics snapshot for meeting (95p/99p latency, token cost, Dedicated utilization). Due: 2026-03-07 EOD.
- Asha: Triage embedding charge spikes for OmniFin; check batching config and rollback window for v1.4. Due: 2026-03-09.
- Claire: Push legal on AcmeHealth KMS review; get ETA and if needed escalate to compliance head. Due: 2026-03-08.
- Jordan: Coordinate with release-engineering on potential hotfix vs. routing policy; call with Priya + Miguel if needed. Due: 2026-03-08 2pm PT.

Open questions / risks to raise in meeting: 
- Do we want to proactively throttle large-embedding jobs on hosted tier to reduce Dedicated contention? (tradeoff: developer friction / billing).
- If hotfix is required, what is our acceptable risk window for canary?

Notes-to-self (scratch):
- Bring up follow-up doc: confluence link above and attach the autoscaler logs + alert history.
- Remind Claire to surface contract SLAs that are at risk if private deploy timelines slip.
- Consider adding short FAQ for sales and CSMs about temporary routing policy to avoid confusion.

Quick drafts for meeting lines: 
- "We have strong demand for Dedicated, but our current ops cadence needs a small set of high-impact fixes (autoscaler thresholds, routing fallback, and better canary tooling). We'll prioritize those this week to avoid contract risk."
- "We're seeing meaningful latency wins in the hosted API — we should highlight that as a product momentum point while acknowledging the p99 tail still needs work."

Parking lot items (not for this meeting):
- Longer-term: regional capacity expansion plan for APAC (Q2 planning)
- Evaluate open-source runtime contributions prioritization (engineering ask)

References / links to share in meeting: 
- Confluence: Exec Staff Notes Q1 2026 (linked_artifacts)
- GitHub PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/681 (kernel tuning changes)
- Slack thread: #ops-autoscaler (see 2026-03-06 thread)

Draft email follow-up template (post-meeting):
- Bullet summary of decisions + owners + dates (copy paste from Follow-ups list)
- Request for any corrections within 24h

Misc: keep this doc informal; will tidy into confluence exec notes after meeting.

-- Jordan
